Hygiene and Waste Controls (Checking Point 3.1)** Hygiene and Sanitation Program (NQGT-HSP-001): • Terminal cleaning: receival pit cleaned weekly; conveyor gallery swept daily; elevator boots washed monthly. • Between commodities: blow-down of all conveyors and elevator legs before changing grain type. • Vessel loading spout cleaned after each vessel loading. • Personnel: safety footwear and dust masks required in operational areas; handwash on entry. • Records: Cleaning Register (NQGT-CLN-01). Waste Management Procedure (NQGT-WMP-001): • Screenings: scalper waste in sealed skip; removed by contractor to composting monthly. • Grain dust: cyclone collector emptied weekly; removed to composting. • Vessel hold washings: water + grain residues pumped to shore reception; disposed per port environmental regulations. • Chemical waste: fumigant sachets disposed per APVMA requirements. **7. No coved skirting at floor-wall junctions. ### 5.2  Contamination and Pest Harbourage Minimisation (C5)

Building envelope sealed to export standard: galvanised mesh (6 mm) on all openings; door brush seals replaced every 2 years; expansion joints filled with flexible polyurethane; no open eaves — soffit board sealed to top of wall cladding; all roof penetrations (vents, conduits) flashed and sealed.
